mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dispatch_task ( activity_id, area_id, position_id, required_count, reason, dispatch_status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{activityId}, #{areaId}, #{positionId}, #{requiredCount}, #{reason}, #{dispatchStatus}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, area_id, position_id, required_count, reason, dispatch_status, created_by, finished_time FROM dispatch_task WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
